name: Orbit Dial
pitch: Concentric orbits turn model share into one circular instrument.
tradeoff: The smallest models shrink to beads, so the legend has to carry their exact share.
fontWhy: Unbounded gives the wordmark a geometric brand voice, Hanken Grotesk stays quiet beside the dial, and Azeret Mono keeps the figures from jittering as the window moves.
logoIdea: An R whose bowl is an open orbit, with one point riding the trace.
sliderIdea: Two handles ride the dial's outer rim and snap to each of the thirty-five days.
signatureMotion: The orbits drift at different speeds while their arcs ease into the new window.
